#!/bin/sh
if [ -x "$HOME/.cargo/bin/cargo" ]; then
  exec "$HOME/.cargo/bin/cargo" "$@"
elif command -v cargo >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  exec cargo "$@"
else
  echo "Cargo not found. Install Rust via rustup." >&2
  exit 9009
fi
